Anagram Generator

Find every real anagram of your word — all unique permutations checked against a built-in word list.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a word up to 8 letters.
  2. Press Find anagrams.
  3. Browse the real words found.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How long can the word be?

Up to 8 letters (8! = 40,320 permutations max), all checked in your browser instantly.

How does it find real words?

A built-in list of common English words filters the permutations down to real words.

What does the count mean?

The count shows real anagrams found out of total unique permutations checked.
